content_blocks.label: clause_1._Notice_of_Non-Payment
content_blocks.text: You are hereby notified that you have failed to pay rent in full for the month of May 2024 as required by your lease agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Deadline
content_blocks.text: You have until June 15, 2024, to remedy the non-payment of rent or vacate the premises immediately.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Legal_Action
content_blocks.text: If the rent is not paid by the deadline, legal action may be initiated against you for eviction.
